# Sven Bischoff

> Personal website of Sven Bischoff, a software developer and tech lead from Leipzig, Germany. Currently Senior Engineering Manager for the "Book" and "App" clusters at ab in den urlaub GmbH, part of the Wirtualna Polska Group, working on ab-in-den-urlaub.de and other travel portals.

Sven's background is in full-stack web development, spanning frontend code, web servers, operating systems and hardware, as well as automation, backups, virtualization, containers and more recently AI. He holds a B.Sc. in Medieninformatik (Media Informatics). Outside of work he is interested in local AI inference, gaming, photography, music, science and DIY.
